title: Preparata and Del Giudice worked with Fleischmann and Pons on cold fusion

tellings.quote: Yes, they were the scientists that worked together to Fleischmann and Pons.

plain: Two scientists at the University of Milan in Italy, Giuliano Preparata and Emilio Del Giudice, are said to have worked with Martin Fleischmann and Stanley Pons on cold fusion, the idea of getting nuclear fusion energy at room temperature, over a span from about 1980 to 2015. A researcher named Filippo Biondi says so, without naming a source. He brings it up to show the serious scientific background of the people he connects to his own work.
